<!-- pr-reviewer: 9f1f7adb1a9134789071250c1ea6d2598f001168 -->

**Verdict: not built - needs a maintainer look.** The hand-resolved merge of main is correct on every check below. No blocker in this delta. Two decisions and one verification wait with a maintainer.

## Scope of this review

This is a delta re-review. The prior clean review covered head `e81cf16e`. The new head `9f1f7adb1` merges main (`2d98d87be`) with a hand-resolved conflict in two files. `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 3062 --reviewed e81cf16e` classes it DELTA. I reviewed only the delta, read-only. I did not build this head: the author is not a collaborator, and `pr-test.yml` builds collaborators' PRs only.

## What looks good

- Both sides of the conflict are kept. `Warning::DrillUndersize` keeps this PR's key `223` (crates/ui/src/operations.rs:302) and main's new `Warning::UndercutLift` arm is kept, moved to `222` (crates/ui/src/operations.rs:305).
- Nothing from main was dropped. `git show --remerge-diff 9f1f7adb1` touches only the two conflicted files. `git diff 2d98d87be..9f1f7adb1` is exactly the PR's own net change (44 lines in operations.rs, 34 in the decision record). The only main commits after `2d98d87be` are docs-only (`998c918bb`) and touch neither file.
- The hand edit `217 -> 222` is correct. `Warning::AvoidHit` owns `216 + part` (crates/ui/src/operations.rs:286) and `FixturePart::Holder` is the second variant, so `217` was a live collision - the same fault as #3040. Full table audit at this head: 200/201 `SweepHit`, 210 `RestUnjudged`, 211 `Scallop`, 212/213 `HolderHit`, 214 `ProbeSearch`, 215 `SinkerFinishOrder`, 216..=220 `AvoidHit`, 221 `FirstTraverseLow` (:276), 222 `UndercutLift` (:305), 223 `DrillUndersize` (:302), 224 `FirstTraverseUnderTable` (:279). No two arms now share a key.
- The new pin exists and is right. `an_undercut_lift_never_hides_an_avoid_hit` (crates/ui/src/operations.rs:648) folds one `UndercutLift`, one `DrillUndersize` and one `AvoidHit` for each of the five parts, and asserts 7 lines (2 + 5) with no "repeated" text on an avoid line.
- The decision-record addendum matches the code, and its correction is true: I verified that open PR #2836 does add `UndercutLift => (217, false)` on its branch, as the addendum says.

## Results

- Not built here (read-only; outside contributor, see Scope).
- The author reports green at this head: `cargo xtask gate quick` 3 steps 0 failed, `warning_fold_tests` 8 passed, `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean, heavy `--dry-run` reaches no lane. I did not reproduce these.
- GitHub reports the head MERGEABLE with main, merge state CLEAN.

## Heavy lanes

The diff maps to the ui suites only; `cargo xtask gate heavy --dry-run` (author's run) reaches no heavy lane.

## Decisions needed from a maintainer

1. Issue #3260 asks for exactly the `UndercutLift -> 222` move this merge lands, with the same style of pin. @sn3ro this PR body ends with `Fixes #3040` only, so #3260 will not close by itself. mkinney already commented on #3260 that it is covered by this PR and closes when it merges. Decide: add `Fixes #3260` to this PR body, or close #3260 by hand at the merge.
2. When PR #2836 next refreshes onto main, its `UndercutLift => (217, false)` arm must take `222`, or it re-introduces the #3260 fault. Whoever refreshes #2836 should keep `222`.
3. A maintainer's own quick pass at this head (ui lib tests, `warning_fold_tests`, `clippy -p camcraft-ui`) would give the independent build reading this review cannot.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/ui/src/operations.rs` is 685 lines, above the ~400-line rule. The PR says so itself and only adds 40. A `P7` split issue is a good follow-up, not a change request here.
- `UndercutLift` blocks the post (`blocks_post`), so the old fold fault was display-only: the post was still held, the pane just hid one line. This confirms the severity is right.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
